spawninfo.hud.problem.no_room: No free space for a mob
spawninfo.hud.problem.too_close: Too close: needs more than 24 blocks
spawninfo.hud.cap_full: Cap full: nothing spawns until there is room
spawninfo.settings.title: Spawn Info: settings
spawninfo.settings.visible.tip: Shows or hides the panel (also the J key).
spawninfo.settings.target.tip: Looked block: the free space in front of the block you look at (up to 128 blocks). Where I stand: your feet.
spawninfo.settings.spot.tip: Biome, block and sky light and your distance to the block.
spawninfo.settings.slime.tip: Whether the chunk is a slime chunk (needs the seed; singleplayer uses the world's).
spawninfo.settings.hostile.tip: Chance of each monster spawning on the block, and the cap of 70.
spawninfo.settings.passive.tip: Chance of each animal spawning on the block, and the cap of 10. The game only tries animals every 20 seconds.
spawninfo.settings.look.tip: How many hostile and passive mobs are where you look (through walls).
spawninfo.settings.cap_adjust.tip: On: the chance drops as the mob cap fills (0% when full). Off: chance with an empty cap.
spawninfo.settings.rows.tip: How many mobs to list per group (most likely first).
spawninfo.settings.range.tip: How many blocks ahead to count mobs.
spawninfo.settings.angle.tip: Width of the view cone used to count mobs ahead.
spawninfo.settings.seed_header: Seed of this world/server (for slime chunks)
spawninfo.settings.status.none: No seed: everything else works, but slime chunks are unknown
spawninfo.settings.status.no_world: Join a world to choose the seed
